question: What time (in seconds) is required for a 238 m long train to cross a 702 m long tunnel, if the train travels at a speed of 36 km/h?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = Length of train + Length of tunnel = 238 + 702 = 940 m

Speed = 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s

Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 940 ÷ 10 = 94 s

**∴ The correct answer is 94 seconds.**
